name: AntennaPod
insteadOf: Spotify Podcasts / Apple Podcasts / Pocket Casts
hook: An easy-to-use, flexible, and completely ad-free podcast player that connects directly to open RSS feeds without platform lock-in or tracking algorithms.
bullets: Subscribe to any podcast via open RSS feeds, iTunes directory, or Fyyd
Auto-download new episodes and stream directly when online
Smart playback: silence skipping, volume boosting, and custom speeds per podcast
Full OPML import/export to easily migrate your library anytime
benefits: No ads injected into podcasts by middleman streaming networks
No account, email, or login required to listen or sync subscriptions
Keep full control over local storage with automated episode cleanup rules
Supports chapters, show notes, playback queue, and sleep timer
setupSteps: Install AntennaPod from F-Droid or Google Play
Search for your favorite podcasts or import an OPML backup file
Configure auto-download preferences and mobile data limits
Enjoy your favorite shows ad-free with silence skipping and custom speeds
details: AntennaPod is the leading open-source podcast player for Android. While commercial apps like Spotify and Apple Podcasts increasingly gate shows behind proprietary walled gardens, insert targeted advertising, and track your listening habits, AntennaPod connects straight to creators' public RSS feeds. It provides power-user audio features — including variable playback speed with pitch preservation, silence trimming, volume boost, and chapter mark navigation — alongside automated download queues and queue management. You never need an account, and your listening history stays private on your device.
setup: App (Android) — install from F-Droid or Google Play
